name: Small covered box
dimensions: with cover: H. 3.3 x Diam. 5 cm (1 5/16 x 1 15/16 in.)
summary: Small circular box and cover with straight sides, the cover lightly domed; light gray stoneware with dark caramel-brown glaze on the exterior and transparent colorless glaze on the interior; base unglazed. From the Huangpu kilns, Tongchuan, Yaozhou county, Shaanxi province.
